reviews.title: Buggy, Scammy, Mediocre
reviews.text: There’s always something wrong with the app, whether is the studio glitching out because you’re mixing  your audio or just poor audio quality. There’s little to no regulation when it comes to covers (pictures used for songs) there is lots of nudity and yes there’s children using the app. They favor specific artist, especially when it comes to being featured. There’s a lot of people on the app trying to scam you and if you want to use any of the features (besides recording raw audio) you have to pay.  It’s still better than recording on your default phone apps like memos, but there are better and more developed apps that give you better results and more accessibility for free. Many people who use the app record else where and just post the finished product on this app for likes.

reviews.title: No longer usable…
reviews.text:
This app used to be incredible. It was designed for normal people to 

1 - select a beat 

2 - create vocals 

3 - edit the vocals with easy to use filters 

4 - publish the song 

Now, after “upgrades”, the app has failed step 3.

They have removed the old filter system and replaced it with a convoluted, time consuming slider system which you need to spend lots of time messing with just to ultimately create a filter that NEVER sounds right. The autotune DOES NOT WORK. I don’t know how else to say it. It’s supposed to auto detect the right pitch, which it never successfully does. So then you’ll spend 15 minutes trying to select the right pitch, only to realize none of them actually work.

This app was perfect and did not need to change. 

It was an excellent place for anyone to download the app and start making music.

After my recent gold membership purchase, I am crushed to discover the app is now essentially useless - and I wasted my money. 

Please Rapchat…. Release the OLD version. Call it “Rapchat classic”. This new one is utterly terrible for the bulk of your customers.
